Chapter 11.3.3.2, Propylene Compressibility Table, 1974

This Fortran IV subroutine is applicable to liquid propylene in the following ranges: temperature, $ 3 0^{\circ} $ to $ 1 6 5^{\circ} \mathrm{F} $ ; and saturation pressure to 1600 psia. The subroutine computes the following two values: density (pounds/ft $ ^{3} $ ) at flowing temperature and pressure, and the ratio of density at flowing conditions to density at $ 6 0^{\circ} \mathrm{F} $ and saturation pressure.
